claim.scope_statement: For every d>=2 and gcd(a,d)=1, the least prime p(a,d) is at most C d^5.2 for one effectively computable absolute C, by Xylouris, arXiv:0906.2749v1, Theorem 1.1. This does not establish the strict bound p(a,d)<d^2 requested in the prompt.
